HOFT.outlook: Outlook “Consumer spending is selective and housing turnover and big-ticket discretionary demand remain weak. The Department of Commerce’s July advance monthly estimates showed retail sales for furniture and home furnishings stores were essentially flat sequentially from June and down 1.2% year-over-year. Existing home sales declined 1.7% month over month to a 4.1 million annualized rate, remaining at historically low levels.
